opportunities.title: Institutional Engagement Award
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applications must be supported by a Society Representative or a Fellow; open to Society members hosting events at their organisation.
opportunities.summary: Provides funding to support Society Representatives and members to host events at their organisation, including internal conferences, teaching symposia, seminars or outreach events.

opportunities.title: Unlocking Futures Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to postdoctoral researchers who require additional support to help them achieve their full potential.
opportunities.summary: Provides support to postdoctoral researchers to help them achieve their full potential, e.g. consumables, registration for HEA Fellowship or other justifiable sundries (not staff salaries).

opportunities.title: Education and Teaching Award
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to members wishing to develop new educational resources or conduct a piece of publishable educational research.
opportunities.summary: Supports members wishing to develop new educational resources or conduct a piece of publishable educational research that addresses a key question in physiological education.

opportunities.title: Research and Knowledge Exchange Award
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to members wishing to conduct pilot studies, develop a new technique or finalise a project, as well as supporting activities to promote knowledge transfer and impact.
opportunities.summary: Supports members to conduct pilot studies, develop a new technique or finalise a project, as well as activities to promote knowledge transfer and impact. Funds animal costs, consumables and small equipment (excluding PCs).

opportunities.title: Equity, Diversity and Inclusion Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to Undergraduate & Masters, Postgraduate, Full member or Fellow of the Physiological Society in their second year of membership, or longer.
opportunities.summary: Provides support for Members to run activities that address the principles of Equity, Diversity and Inclusion, intended for projects that directly investigate or address inclusion and diversity issues in the physiological sciences in teaching or research.
